nodes.label: backend/.env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template for the GeoLead AI backend. Declares configuration keys for the HTTP server (PORT, CORS_ORIGIN), PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL), Redis/BullMQ (REDIS_URL), external APIs (SERPER_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_MODEL), and the outbound email platform (OUTBOUND_BASE_URL, OUTBOUND_ADMIN_EMAIL, OUTBOUND_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS, OUTBOUND_SECRET_KEY, OUTBOUND_QUEUE_INTERVAL_MS, OUTBOUND_QUEUE_MODE).

nodes.label: backend/Procfile
nodes.summary: Heroku process definition for the backend. Declares a release phase that runs Prisma migrations (npx prisma migrate deploy), a web process serving the compiled Express server (node dist/server.js), and a worker process running the BullMQ job worker (node dist/workers/worker.js).

nodes.label: backend/package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for geolead-ai-backend (scraping and lead scoring engine). Defines scripts (dev/dev:watch via tsx, worker, tsc build, start, postinstall prisma generate, db:migrate, db:studio, db:generate), Node engine constraint >=20 <23, and dependencies: Prisma client, axios, bcryptjs, bullmq, cheerio, cors, dotenv, express, imapflow, ioredis, jsonwebtoken, mailparser, xlsx, plus TypeScript/tsx dev tooling.

nodes.label: backend/tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend. Targets ES2022 with NodeNext module/moduleResolution, outputs to ./dist from rootDir ./src, enables strict mode, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames, and resolveJsonModule. Includes src/**/*.
